t: The $(item)Amadron Tablet/$ is an item that can be used to $(thing)order/$ items and fluids for delivery by $(l:tools/drone)Drones/$.$(p)To do so, an inventory and/or fluid tank needs to be selected by $(thing)right-clicking/$ with the tablet to bind it. This inventory/tank is then used to take items as payment, and receive the items you ordered.
$(item)亚马龙平板电脑/$是一种可用于通过$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$配送来$(thing)订购/$物品和流体的物品。$(p)要这样做，你需要手持平板对一个容器和/或流体储罐进行$(thing)右击/$，将其绑定。之后，这个容器/储罐会用于扣除作为付款的物品，并接收你订购的物品。

The tablet GUI is smart enough to figure out what you can buy by looking at the bound inventory and/or tank. When you order $(ttcolor)$(t:Resources can be either items or fluids)resources/$, a $(thing)Drone/$ will spawn to collect the resources you're paying with. Once collection is complete, a second $(thing)Drone/$ will arrive to deliver the purchased items.$(p)This is a way to get items you can't get otherwise, like the $(l:components/pcb_blueprint)PCB Blueprint/$ and $(l:manufacturing/assembly_programs)Assembly Programs/$. It also adds some random $(thing)Villager Trades/$; these trades are re-shuffled daily.

平板界面会通过查看已绑定的容器和/或储罐，智能判断你能够购买什么。当你订购$(ttcolor)$(t:Resources can be either items or fluids)资源/$时，会生成一只$(thing)雄蜂/$来收集你用于支付的资源。收集完成后，第二只$(thing)雄蜂/$会到来并送达你购买的物品。$(p)这是一种获取原本无法获得物品的方法，例如$(l:components/pcb_blueprint)印刷电路板蓝图/$和$(l:manufacturing/assembly_programs)装配程序/$。它还会添加一些随机的$(thing)村民交易/$；这些交易每天都会重新刷新。

By clicking the $(bold)Custom Player Trade/$ button (on the $(bold)Custom Trades/$ side tab) you can offer your own resources to be traded for other players' resources. In the trading GUI you can select an resource to sell on the left-hand side, and a resource you want to buy on the right-hand side. You can set the trade amounts with the text fields.
点击$(bold)自定义交易/$侧边标签上的$(bold)添加自定义玩家交易/$按钮后，你就可以拿出自己的资源，与其他玩家的资源进行交易。在自定义商店界面中，你可以在左侧选择要出售的资源，在右侧选择想要购买的资源。你可以通过文本框设置交易数量。

You can also specify in the GUI where you want to provide the resources from, and where you want to receive payment from other players. You will need a $(l:tools/gps_tool)GPS Tool/$ (set to the right location) for this.$(p)If you don't specify custom locations here, the default locations stored in the tablet (for normal trades) will be used.
你还可以在 GUI 中指定你想从哪里提供资源，以及想从哪里接收其他玩家的付款。为此，你需要一个$(l:tools/gps_tool)定位工具/$（设置为正确的位置）。$(p)如果你不在这里指定自定义位置，就会使用存储在平板中的默认位置（用于普通交易）。

When all is set, the $(bold)Add Trade/$ button will become clickable. This trade will be visible to other players in their $(item)Amadron Tablet/$ just like any normal offers.$(p)An important difference is that there is no unlimited stock: you must add your resources to the selling inventory/tank. A $(thing)Drone/$ will arrive to pick up these resources; when pick-up is complete, the stock will be increased. Stock levels for custom offers are shown in the $(item)Amadron Tablet/$ GUI.
当一切设置完成后，$(bold)添加交易/$按钮就会变为可点击。该交易会像其他普通报价一样，显示在其他玩家的$(item)亚马龙平板电脑/$中。$(p)一个重要的区别是，这里没有无限库存：你必须将你的资源放入出售用的容器/储罐中。随后会有一只$(thing)雄蜂/$前来取走这些资源；当取货完成后，库存就会增加。自定义报价的库存量会显示在$(item)亚马龙平板电脑/$ GUI 中。

Other players can now accept the offer up to the amount that is in stock. When a player accepts an offer you'll be notified (provided you are online), and a $(thing)Drone/$ will arrive to deliver you the resources that the other player paid you with. A trade has been completed!
现在其他玩家可以接受该报价，最多接受当前库存中的数量。当有玩家接受报价时，你会收到通知（前提是你在线），并且会有一台$(thing)雄蜂/$抵达，将另一位玩家支付给你的资源运送给你。一笔交易已完成！

By $(thing)shift-clicking/$ the $(#F00)x/$ button on one of your own trades in the Amadron GUI, the trade will be removed, and Amadron will attempt to return your resources to the inventory/tank that provided it. $(p)$(bold)Warning:/$ Amadron take no responsibility for resources lost in the event of a problem returning them!
在亚马龙 GUI 中，对你自己的某个交易的$(#F00)x/$按钮进行$(thing)Shift+单击/$，即可移除该交易，亚马龙会尝试将你的资源返还到提供这些资源的容器/储罐中。$(p)$(bold)警告：/$如果在返还过程中出现问题而导致资源丢失，亚马龙概不负责！
